linkedRules.description:
All Drukhari units have a Pain ability, tagged with the word 'Pain'. Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. If your Army Faction is Drukhari, you can Empower units from your army with Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens (see below).

GAINING PAIN TOKENS

If your Army Faction is Drukhari, you gain Pain tokens as follows:
- 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase.
- 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit is destroyed.
- 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

Each time you gain a Pain token, keep it to one side - this is your Pain token pool. Each time you spend a Pain token, reduce your Pain token pool by the same amount.

EMPOWERED THROUGH PAIN

Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in that unit take effect - you do not need to spend additional Pain tokens to activate each of those Pain abilities.

linkedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is Asuryani, at the start of the battle round, you receive a number of Battle Focus tokens based on the battle size, as shown below:

- Incursion - 2
- Strike Force - 4
- Onslaught - 6

Each time one of the triggers shown in the Agile Manoeuvres section of your codex occurs, you can spend one Battle focus token to enable the relevant eligible unit to perform that Agile Manoeuvre. A unit is eligible to perform an Agile Manoeuvre if it has this ability and has not already performed an Agile Manoeuvre in the same phase. Unless otherwise stated, you cannot trigger the same Agile Manoeuvre more than once per phase. At the end of the battle round, all unspent Battle Focus tokens are lost.

No Harlequins or Anhrathe models included in your army in this way can be your Warlord, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

enhancements.name: Leechbite Plate
enhancements.description: Archon model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+. At the start of either player's Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token: if you do, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Webway Awl
enhancements.description: Archon model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability, and you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Informant Network
enhancements.description: Archon model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three Kabalite Warriors and/or Hand of the Archon units from your army; those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Towering Arrogance
enhancements.description: Archon model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

rules.name: Alliance of Agony
rules.description:
At the start of the battle, you gain 2 Pain tokens for each of the following combinations your army contains (these do not need to be in the same Attached unit):
- One or more Archon models and one or more Kabalite Warriors units.
- One or more Succubus models and one or more Wyches units.
- One or more Haemonculus models and one or more Wracks units.

Designer's Note: These are all cumulative, so if your army contains at least one of all of the combinations listed above, you start the battle with 6 Pain tokens.

rules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
rules.description:
If your Army Faction is Drukhari, you can include Harlequins and Anhrathe units in your army, even though they do not have the Drukhari Faction keyword. The combined points value of Harlequins and/or Anhrathe units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:
- Incursion: Up to 250 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 500 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 750 pts
No Harlequins or Anhrathe models included in your army in this way can be your Warlord, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

enhancements.name: Dark Vitality
enhancements.description: DRUKHARI model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities.

enhancements.name: Labyrinthine Cunning
enhancements.description:
Archon model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: Eye of Spite
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 2 instead.

enhancements.name: Crucible of Malediction
enhancements.description: Haemonculus model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a PSYKER unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Callous Competition
rules.description:
At the start of the battle, Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager.
Each time a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager.
Each time a Harlequins unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, Harlequin units from your army are winning the wager.
While Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager, Harlequin units from your army are losing the wager, and vice versa.
Each time a Drukhari or Harlequins model from your army makes an attack, if that model's unit is winning the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model's unit is losing the wager, reroll a Hit roll of 1 and reroll a Wound roll of 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Archraider
enhancements.description: Harlequins or Drukhari model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a Dedicated Transport, that DEDICATED TRANSPORT has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: Webway Walker
enhancements.description: Harlequins or Drukhari model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer's unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Reaper's Cowl
enhancements.description: Harlequins model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

enhancements.name: Conductor of Torment
enhancements.description:
Drukhari model only. In your Command phase, you
can do one of the following:
If your DRUKHARI units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, DRUKHARI units from your army are now winning the wager.If your DRUKHARI units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, Harlequins units from your army are now winning the wager.

rules.name: Strands of Fate
rules.description:
At the start of the first battle round, you generate Fate dice by rolling a number of D6 based on the battle size, as shown below. Keep your Fate dice to one side - this is your Fate dice pool.

- Incursion - 3
- Strike Force - 6
- Onslaught - 9

Each time you use one of the detachment Stratagems, if your Fate dice pool contains one or more Fate dice showing the corresponding value in the table below, you can discard one of those corresponding Fate dice. If you do, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

- Presentiment of Dread - 1
- Forewarned - 2
- Unshrouded Truth - 3
- Fate Inescapable - 4

- Isha's Fury - 5
- Psychic Shield - 6

rules.name: Boons of the Brood
rules.description: Weapons equipped by Harlequins Mounted and Harlequins Vehicle models from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Each time a Harlequins unit from your army disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn, that unit's weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Travelling Players
rules.description:
Troupe units from you army gain the Battleline keyword and Troupe models in those units have an Objective Control characteristic of 2.
You can include up to three of each of the following models in your army: Death Jester, Shadowseer, Troupe Master.

rules.name: Rain of Cruelty
rules.description:
Each time a Drukhari unit from your army disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn:
Ranged weapons equipped by models in that disembarking units have the [Ignores Cover] ability.
Melee weapons equipped by models in that disembarking unit have the [Lance] ability.

rules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
rules.description:
If your Army Faction is Drukhari, you can include Harlequins and Anhrathe units in your army, even though they do not have the Drukhari Faction keyword. The combined points value of Harlequins and/or Anhrathe units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:
- Incursion: Up to 250 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 500 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 750 pts
No Harlequins or Anhrathe models included in your army in this way can be your Warlord, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

enhancements.name: Phantasmal Smoke
enhancements.description:
DRUKHARI model only. While the bearer's unit is wholly within 6" of a friendly Drukhari Transport:
Models in the bearer's unit have the Stealth ability.Each time a ranged attack targets the bearer's unit, models in that unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Sadistic Fulcrum
enhancements.description: DRUKHARI model only. Each time you spend 1 Pain token to Empower the bearer's unit in the Shooting phase, select one friendly Drukhari Transport within 6" of the bearer's unit; until the end of the phase, each time that TRANSPORT makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Raider
enhancements.description: DRUKHARI model only. Each time the bearer's unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase, if that enemy unit was within range of one or more objective markers when the bearer's unit was selected to fight, you gain 1 additional Pain token.

enhancements.name: Nightmare Shroud
enhancements.description: DRUKHARI model only. Each time the bearer's unit disembarks from a Transport, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

rules.name: Combat Drugs
rules.description:
At the start of your Command phase, select which Combat Drugs will be active for your army until the start of your next Command phase. To do so, either select one from the list below (you cannot select the same Combat Drug more than once per battle), or randomly select two by rolling two D6. When doing so randomly, Combat Drugs you have previously selected can become active again, but if you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

1. Adrenalight
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Wych Cult models from your army.

2. Hypex
Add 2" to the Move characteristic of Wych Cult models from your army.

3. Serpentin
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Wych Cult models from your army by 1.

4. Painbringer
Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of Wych CUlt models from your army.

5. Grave Lotus
Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by Wych Cult models from your army.

6. Splintermind
Improve the Leadership characteristic of Wych Cult models from your army by 1, and improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by Wych Cult models from your army by 1.

rules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
rules.description:
If your Army Faction is Drukhari, you can include Harlequins and Anhrathe units in your army, even though they do not have the Drukhari Faction keyword. The combined points value of Harlequins and/or Anhrathe units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:
- Incursion: Up to 250 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 500 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 750 pts
No Harlequins or Anhrathe models included in your army in this way can be your Warlord, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

enhancements.name: Pharmacophex
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. At the start of your Command phase, after selecting which Combat Drugs will be active for your army, roll one D6 and consult the Combat Drugs list. The result rolled applies to the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase in addition to any other Combat Drugs that are active for your army. If you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

enhancements.name: Chronoshard
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Periapt of Torments
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Morghenna's Curse
enhancements.description: Succubus model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of the bearers melee weapons by 1.

rules.name: Shepherds of the Dead
rules.description:
Each time an Asuryani Psyker model from your army is destroyed by an enemy unit, that unit gains a Vengeful Dead token. Each time a Wraith Construct model from your army makes an attack that targets a unit with one or more Vengeful Dead tokens, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
Asuryani Psyker models from your army have the following ability:
Spirit Guides (Aura): while a Wraithblades, Wraithguard or Wraithlord unit from your army is within 12" of this model, that unit has the Battle Focus ability.

Wraithblades and Wraithguard units from your army gains the Battleline keyword.

rules.name: Martial Grace
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round, you receive 1 additional Battle Focus token.
Each time a unit from your army performs the Swift as the Wind Agile Manoeuvre, until the end of the phase, add an additional 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit.
Each time a unit from your army performs an Agile Manoeuvre that involves rolling a D6, add 1 to the result.

rules.name: Ride the Wind
rules.description:
In the Declare Battle Formations step you can set up Asuryani Mounted and Vyper units in Reserves.
During the battle, such units can be set up on the battlefield as if they were arriving from Strategic Reserves. For the purposes of setting up Asuyani Mounted or Vyper units from your army on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

In addition, at the end of your opponent's turn, you can select a number of Asuryani Mounted or Vyper units from your army (excluding units within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units), then remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves. The maximum number of units you can select depends on the battle size, as shown below:

- Incursion - 1
- Strike Force - 2
- Onslaught - 3

Windriders units from your army gain the Battleline keyword.

stratagems.name: COMMAND RE-ROLL
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple rolls or saving throws at once.
stratagems.target: That unit or model from your army.
stratagems.effect: You re-roll that roll, test or saving throw. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those rolls or saving throws to re-roll.
stratagems.legend: A great commander can bend even the vagaries of fate and fortune to their will, the better to ensure victory.

stratagems.name: GO TO GROUND
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have a 6+ invulnerable save and have the Benefit of Cover.
stratagems.legend: Seeking salvation from incoming fire, warriors hurl themselves into whatever cover they can find.

stratagems.name: INSANE BRAVERY
stratagems.when: Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army.
stratagems.target: That unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit automatically passes that Battle-shock test.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: Indifferent to their own survival, these warriors hold their ground against seemingly impossible odds.

stratagems.name: EPIC CHALLENGE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a CHARACTER unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: One CHARACTER model in your unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all melee attacks made by that model have the [PRECISION] ability.
stratagems.legend: The legends of the 41st Millennium are replete with deadly duels between mighty champions.

stratagems.name: HEROIC INTERVENTION
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 6" of that enemy unit and would be eligible to declare a charge against that enemy unit if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge as if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You can only select a VEHICLE unit from your army if it is a WALKER. Note that even if this charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.legend: Voices raised in furious war cries, your warriors surge forth to meet the enemy's onslaught head-on.

stratagems.name: COUNTER-OFFENSIVE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and that has not already been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit fights next.
stratagems.legend: In close-quarters combat, the slightest hesitation can leave an opening for a swift foe to exploit.

stratagems.name: TANK SHOCK
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, just after a VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.target: That VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, and select one VEHICLE model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to the Toughness characteristic of the selected VEHICLE model. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: Ramming the foe with a speeding vehicle may be an unsubtle tactic, but it is a murderously effective one.

stratagems.name: RAPID INGRESS
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, and if every model in that unit has the Deep Strike ability, you can set that unit up as described in the Deep Strike ability (even though it is not your Movement phase).
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem to enable a unit to arrive on the battlefield during a battle round it would not normally be able to do so in.
stratagems.legend: Be it cunning strategy, potent technology or supernatural ritual, there are many means by which a commander may hasten their warriors' onset.

stratagems.name: FIRE OVERWATCH
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up or when an enemy unit starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One unit from your army that is within 24" of that enemy unit and that would be eligible to shoot if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.effect: If that enemy unit is visible to your unit, your unit can shoot that enemy unit as if it were your Shooting phase.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot target a TITANIC unit with this Stratagem. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers. You can only use this Stratagem once per turn.
stratagems.legend: A hail of wildfire can drive back advancing foes.

stratagems.name: GRENADE
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One GRENADES unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Select one GRENADES model in your unit and one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 8" of and visible to your GRENADES model. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
stratagems.legend: Priming their hand-held projectiles, these warriors draw back and hurl death into the enemy's midst.

stratagems.name: SMOKESCREEN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.
stratagems.legend: Even the most skilled marksmen struggle to hit targets veiled by billowing screens of smoke.

stratagems.name: NEW ORDERS
stratagems.when: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One of your active Secondary Mission cards.
stratagems.effect: Discard it and draw one new Secondary Mission card.
stratagems.legend: High command has received new intelligence.

stratagems.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a Haemonculus Covens unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
stratagems.legend: These epicureans of extreme sensation revel in their agonies as much as those of the foe.

stratagems.name: POSTMORTALITY
stratagems.when: Any phase.
stratagems.target: One Haemonculus model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set the destroyed model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, with a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
stratagems.legend: To the greatest Haemonculi, death is but an intriguing and temporary state to be experienced.

stratagems.name: POISONER'S ART
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Haemonculus Covens unit from your army has fought.
stratagems.target: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit's attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.legend: The venoms wielded by these warriors are potent enough to impress Shaimesh himself.

stratagems.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
stratagems.target: That DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a Haemonculus Covens unit.
stratagems.legend: So extreme are the foe's agonies that they spread a shock wave of terror through their comrades.

stratagems.name: ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6: your unit can be moved a number of inches up to the result, but it must end that move as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (excluding AIRCRAFT). When doing so, those models can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.
stratagems.legend: Even as the prey seek to drive the covenites back with hails of firepower, the horrors lurch closer.

stratagems.name: DISTILLERS OF FEAR
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.legend: By arcane syringe and unholy invocation, the enemy's terror is syphoned out of their bodies, leaving them as little more than contorted husks.

stratagems.name: TAKEN ALIVE
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent's army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
stratagems.legend: Borne away screaming into the shadows, everyone knows these unfortunates face a dreadful fate.

stratagems.name: MAKING A POINT
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.legend: Whether seeking to impress a watching Archon, show up rivals or revel in their supremacy, these marksmen fire for spiteful effect.

stratagems.name: TAILORED TOXINS
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.legend: Specially prepared for their chosen prey, these malignant poisons are the anathema of their targets.

stratagems.name: ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
stratagems.target: One Archon WARLORD from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent's army that is on the battlefield and matches the 'Contract' description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
stratagems.legend: This Archon's personal kill list of rivals, nemeses and victims is virtually never-ending.

stratagems.name: DOUBLE-CROSS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks, and one friendly Drukhari unit (excluding Vehicles).
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: What better way to eliminate rivals than tricking them into taking the blade meant for your ribs?

stratagems.name: DEADLY DECEIVERS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Kabal or Blades for Hire unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
stratagems.legend: A life lived amidst the shadowed spires of Commorragh teaches many ways to creep up on your enemies, unseen and unsuspected.

stratagems.name: INSENSIBLE TO PAIN
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Haemonculus Covens unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.legend: The twisted creations of the haemonculus covens are uncaring of all but the most mortal injuries.

stratagems.name: EAGER FOR THE KILL
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Wyches units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the Reavers' Matchless Swiftness ability).
stratagems.legend: The exhilarating promise of bloodshed goads these warriors into battle with preternatural haste.

stratagems.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Drukhari Battleline units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
stratagems.legend: It is hardwired into the Drukhari psyche to prey upon weakened and suffering victims.

stratagems.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army (excluding Haemonculus Covens units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: Even attempting to strike the Drukhari is like trying to lay a blade to smoke, so sly and swift are they.

stratagems.name: DARK HARVEST
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Wracks units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.legend: Wicked sickles and serrated blades hack through writhing flesh as the Drukhari harvest agony and suffering.

stratagems.name: RAID AND FADE
stratagems.when: End of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: Up to two Kabalite Warriors units from your army, or one other Drukhari unit from your army (excluding ScouRGES and Aircraft).
stratagems.effect: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: The Drukhari are masters at using hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before quickly manoeuvring into cover or out of sight.

stratagems.name: MALICIOUS FRENZY
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
stratagems.legend: Jealous competition descends into frenzied carnage as the kill count climbs higher and the intoxicating screams of the dying fill the air.

stratagems.name: MURDERER'S CIRCUS
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.legend: In bounding leaps and graceful pirouettes, the cavalcade of capricious killers bounds through hails of fire, cackling gleefully as they come.

stratagems.name: DANCE MACABRE
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari Infantry or Harlequins Infantry unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
stratagems.legend: The saedath's victims become unwitting partners in a frantic dance of ghastly slaughter.

stratagems.name: SHORTEN THE ODDS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army has Advanced.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.legend: Having selected their victims, these killers strive to complete the kill with speed and brutality whilst moving ever closer to winning their macabre wager.

stratagems.name: FATEFUL ROLE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model's unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: These warriors are so absorbed by their desire to win the wager that they risk death to land their killing blows.

stratagems.name: SCINTILLATING TEMPO
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a Drukhari or Harlequins unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
stratagems.legend: Commorrite or Harlequin, these lithe combatants move with stunning speed, darting in and out of firing lines before their foes can raise their weapons.

stratagems.name: SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a Transport this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a Kabalite Warriors or Hand of the Archon unit.
stratagems.legend: These warriors are well versed in raining suppressing fire on the foe even as they close with them from on high, shredding defences and leaving the survivors easy prey for the raid.

stratagems.name: VICIOUS BLADES
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a Drukhari Transport from your army has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: That TRANSPORT.
stratagems.effect: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a Wracks model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.legend: Wielding a horrifying array of hooked boarding blades, barbed lariats and other specialised tools of agony, these warriors hack and slash at their foes even as their transport skims low overhead.

stratagems.name: SWOOPING MOCKERY
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari Transport from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.legend: The crew of this skimmer delight in evading and taunting their enemies with mocking ease.

stratagems.name: POUNCE ON THE PREY
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari Infantry unit from your army disembarks from a Transport that made a Normal move this phase.
stratagems.target: That INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.legend: Incredible alien agility and a delight in taking wild risks help these warriors to leap acrobatically from their skimming transports directly into battle.

stratagems.name: WRAITHLIKE RETREAT
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari Infantry unit from your army that fought this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a Wyches unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly Drukhari Transport and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move).
stratagems.legend: Employing smoke grenades, paralysing mists or simple cunning and agility, these warriors slip away like spectres.

stratagems.name: NIGHT SHIELD
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Drukhari Vehicle unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: These powerful Drukhari devices occlude their raiding vehicles from physical sight, targeting sensors, and even psychic senses.

stratagems.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.legend: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.

stratagems.name: A CHALLENGE MET
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that would be able to declare a charge if it were your Charge phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of your unit that was set up on the battlefield this phase or that ended a Normal or Advance move this phase. Your unit now declares a charge that targets only that enemy unit, and you resolve that charge.
stratagems.restrictions: Even if that charge is successful, your unit does not receive any Charge bonus this turn.
stratagems.legend: The foe's advance is not something to be wary of but rather an opportunity to be seized.

stratagems.name: DEADLY DEBUT
stratagems.when: Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Wyches unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
stratagems.legend: Imitating Lelith Hesperax, these warriors begin their gladiatorial bout with an opening so spectacularly violent that none can fail to be impressed.

stratagems.name: PRETERNATURAL AGILITY
stratagems.when: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
stratagems.legend: Bounding and weaving, the Wyches cross the battlefield with unmatched acrobatic agility.

stratagems.name: BERSERK FUGUE
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One Wych Cult unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.legend: The cult's gladiators enter a killing trance when combat is joined, allowing them to fight on through the most grievous hurts with undimmed ferocity.

stratagems.name: FEIGNED WEAKNESS
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a Drukhari unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.target: That DRUKHARI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.legend: Employing a common ruse from the arenas, the Drukhari appear to cower, wounded and exhausted, before surging back at their overconfident opponents with blades and fangs bared.
